titulo.estudio: Une brève locale : Observer les formes
titulo.alumno: A local news brief: vocabulary and forms

intro: Extract what happened, where and when from a local news item. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Extract what happened, where and when from a local news item. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: the passé composé presents the event; the imparfait can describe the context already under way. In this passage, «travaux» means «works».

frases.estudio: Les travaux ont duré six mois et ont coûté moins cher que prévu.
frases.alumno: The works lasted six months and cost less than expected.

frases.estudio: Pendant la cérémonie, les habitants ont planté des arbres et visité le jardin.
frases.alumno: During the ceremony, the residents planted trees and visited the garden.
